notes.title: Investigating Issues
notes.content:
[h1]Notice to Players[/h1]
[h3]We are investigating issues related to the current build of the game[/h3]

[b]Below is a list of known bugs that our team is aware of and working to fix[/b]
[list]
[*] The average slime temperature in the tank does not display the correct temperature
[*] All slime becomes "hot" slime once the tank breaks
[*] Temperature-related event slimes increase both hot and cold slime production
[/list]

If you are experiencing these issues, please rest assured that our team is hard at work handling them and will be pushing a patch to fix them soon. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

If you have experienced any other bugs or performance-related issues not listed here, please feel free to share them in response, so that we may address them promptly.

Thank you for your patience,
[b]-The Slime Co. Team[/b]

notes.title: Bug fixes and small changes
notes.content:
Fixed temperature bugs with the slime in the tank
